'''TD Observatory''' is an area of [[Black Shores Archipelago]], [[The Black Shores]]. The TD Observatory is where Black Shores stores [[Tacet Discord]] data gathered from around the world. The data will then be converted into digital [[Reverberation]]s and transferred to the [[Tethys System]] underground as the building blocks of the data space within the Infinite Reality Sandbox.<ref>[[Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 1#TD Observatory|Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 1, TD Observatory]]
